apps.name: Resona
apps.subtitle: YouTube Music client in Material 3 Expressive
apps.localizedDescription: Resona is a YouTube Music client for iPhone and iPad with dynamic cover colours, word-synced karaoke lyrics, downloads and a Material 3 Expressive design.

versions.localizedDescription:
- PS5 stick on the iPad released (the PS5 plays format 2; it shows no covers for USB music): no switch, Settings → Downloads → PS5 stick with the cover hint, German texts, only the app's own .m4a downloads are copied
- Docs: lyrics depth measured on the Pixel

- CLAUDE.md: pixel-adb skill for Android device tests
- Docs: EQ per output device
- EQ per output device (iPad): the equalizer is remembered per output (iPad speaker, Bluetooth name, AirPlay name) and switches with the route, hint 'EQ: <preset> for <device>'; EQ screen shows 'Applies to: <device>', 'Same for all devices' and 'Use default EQ'; unknown devices use the default EQ; unit tests for mapping and switching
- Docs: no unmeasured accuracy claim
- Docs: round 12 closing numbers (CTC runtime in the simulator, UI test findings)
- UI test: elapsed time read from the leftmost time label (the other one can show the remaining time, read as a jump to 243 s)

- PS5 stick view: import UniformTypeIdentifiers; docs: round 12 closing section
- Test: CTC forced alignment on the same synthetic speech as the Whisper pipeline test, runtime printed for the docs (round 12, point 3)
- PS5 stick on the iPad, prepared behind a switch (round 12, point 7): same layout and manifest as Resona-Android (Music/<Playlist>/NN - Artist - Title.m4a, Music/.resona-sync.json with format version, FAT32-safe names, only manifest files moved or deleted), stick picked in the Files picker (bookmark), manual sync; visible only in developer mode with 'PS5 stick (preview)' on until the PS5 cover test

- UI test test1Portrait: drop menu opened with retries (button or menu item), jump checked as two jumps landing on the same spot instead of 'moved by more than 4 s', leftover menu dismissed before the lyrics pill, lyrics pill tapped again when the player is still in front; live suggestions depend on YouTube answering the runner and are only noted
- AI sync on the iPad like Android (round 12): CTC forced alignment (wav2vec2-base-960h int8, ONNX Runtime) is the default when the lyrics are known and Latin script; WhisperKit for lyrics from audio, non-Latin lyrics and as fallback; same aligner and calibration; synthetic tests shared with Android incl. German placeholder lyrics
- Docs: round 11 closing summary with open items

- Docs: round 12 point 2 (speakers) and the open iPad stick item
- Docs: round 12 point 1 released as v0.8.19
- CI: skip the AI sync speech test when macOS say writes only silence (the runner image's voice gave 0.005 s)
- Docs: round 12 progress (playback errors), alignment table
- Speakers: button in the bottom row between sleep timer and lyrics (same place as on Android, visible in every player style)
- Speakers (round 12): the player's output button opens a glass sheet — current output with name, the system list (iPad, Bluetooth devices in range, AirPlay) and a hint to pair new Bluetooth devices in the iPad settings; on an external output the button shows icon + name, the mini player too

- Playback error hint: refused streams recognized by their readable text too (the enum printed as validationFailed(…) fell through to the generic hint)
- Playback (round 12): one YouTube client after the other with an error log — every attempt logged (time, song id, client, stage, HTTP status, redacted text), a client that failed for a song is skipped for it for 10 min, a stream the player can't load moves on to the next client (failed loads of a new song were ignored: the id was still pending); chain like Android plus WEB and MWEB, without the dead embedded client; Settings → About → Share error log; error banner with Retry
- Docs: AI sync on Android

- Recognition: use the global withUnsafeBytes inside the Data extension
- Music recognition on the iPad (round 11 C): waveform button in the search bar, listens 8.4 s, signature ported byte for byte from Android (same endpoint, ShazamKit depends on an app service a re-signed app can't count on), play the match from YouTube Music, list of recognized songs; nothing is recorded or kept; tests against the same reference as Android, UI test with an invented song
- Docs: round 11 status
- Docs: lyrics blur stays iPad-only
- Docs: lyrics depth on Android not aligned yet
- Docs: Immersive UI test green
- Immersive: the container's accessibility id no longer replaces the disc's and controls' ids (UI test could not find them); docs
- UI tests: Immersive test always starts the app fresh (it ran on the previous test's app: other style, lyrics open); queue rows are one accessibility element, so the row id covers the whole row (swipe and handle drag hit the artwork before) and VoiceOver reads one song with actions

- Docs: open UI-test points that predate round 11 G
- Docs: AMOLED is on both platforms (iPad already had Pure black)
- Docs: alignment table (glass, lyrics pill, lyrics depth/glide, queue, AI sync)
- Queue: reorder by the handle only — a long-press drag on the whole row kept the List from scrolling and swiping (UI test); Immersive: controls measured at their natural height (a filling child left no room for the disc); UI test reads row titles from the accessibility labels
- Docs: round 11 G1/G2 (Immersive layout, queue drag preview), gradient measurement on the Pixel
- Queue drag-to-reorder (round 11): own reorder instead of List.onMove — the lifted row is an opaque, rounded copy in the panel colour with a soft shadow, inset to the panel width; the other rows slide aside to open the gap; handle drags at once, long press anywhere on the row; VoiceOver move up/down actions; layout tests for every iPad size (full screen, side panel, Split View, Stage Manager), reorder tests, Immersive UI test
- Immersive layout fix (round 11): header in its own strip, disc as large as fits with title and controls below in one centred block; controls and header fade but keep their space, so the disc never moves; short windows drop the toggle row, then the header; a collapse drag cancelled by a competing gesture snaps the player back (it stayed shifted down, pushing queue/lyrics off screen and showing a hard background edge); collapse drag fully off while the side panel is open
- Docs: round 11 progress (A/B released, E/F)
- Lyrics (round 11): blur only from the distance to the active line (symmetric, constant from 4, no sharp lines further away — iPad portrait bug); tempo check uses queue/metadata length and re-checks once the player knows it; UI test with placeholder lyrics in portrait/landscape; tests
- Player background = colour gradient only (round 11): canvas clip plays invisibly, a 24×24 frame per second is quantised into four colours the mesh fades to; without canvas the cover colours flow; pauses with playback, while hidden and in Low Power Mode; readable colour limits; all player styles (Editorial/Immersive now on the gradient too); setting canvas/cover/static; tests

- iPad: queue and player menu as side panel in portrait too (the form sheet left the list almost no height)
- iPad fixes (round 11): Immersive shows controls on tap and hides them after 4 s (always with VoiceOver), backdrop no longer pushes them off screen; queue scrolls (no player collapse drag while the side panel is open, list scrolls before the sheet resizes, no competing long press); UI test with a 60-song queue; genre tiles proof screenshot
- Docs: round 10 done (part B status, open item AI sync on Android)
- Docs: round 10 part A complete

- Saved tracks (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): Spotify 'Liked Songs' with the existing Spotify login (GraphQL fetchLibraryTracks), matched to YouTube Music on play (duration-aware, cached) and queued progressively; library tile when Spotify is connected; tests
- Docs: Feather (round 10) [skip ci]

- Updates via Feather: 'Install in Feather' opens feather://install/<ipa> (scheme verified in Feather's source), fallback downloads the IPA with progress and opens the share sheet; 'Add source to Feather' in About; ESign texts → Feather (banner, About, README, CI comments); tests

- Podcasts (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): episode search on podcast pages; docs A8; tests
- Library (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): export playlists as CSV (share sheet, Excel-safe UTF-8), local music imported from the Files app with metadata and cover, playing offline like downloads; tests

- Fix: lastSeenKey nonisolated
- Fix: OnboardingState.isExistingInstall nonisolated for unit tests
- Fix: PlaybackErrorCenter.describe nonisolated (unit tests call it synchronously)
- Stats (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): listening statistics per period (minutes, plays, streak, top artists / songs / albums, time of day + listener type, weekdays), recap stories with artwork wall and count-up, share the summary as image, non-destructive undoable reset; tests
- Home (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): staggered genre tiles with their own shapes, 'Discover genres' on Home (daily pick), genre pages with colour header, featured cards for the first playlist shelf and the community shelf, more varied Quick Picks; tests
- Player (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): Editorial style (die-cut cover morphing squircle ↔ scalloped disc, serif headline, bento controls), Immersive style (full-screen canvas or turning cover disc), 'Blurred cover' background, rotate-cover switch, artist picker for several artists, codec + sample rate in the audio details, artwork placeholder; docs; tests
- App (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): 'What's new' after an update from the GitHub release notes (New / Improved / Fixed, all versions since the last seen one, also in Settings → About), first-launch onboarding with optional YouTube Music sign-in, update banner shows the sorted notes; tests
- Queue (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): YouTube recommendation chips replace the upcoming songs, 'Play next' moves the song (swipe right or row menu), multi-select with play next / remove, empty state; tests
- Playback (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): playback stream resolution before downloads, 'preload next song' switch, 'prevent audio interruptions' (mix with other apps, session + mpv consistent), SponsorBlock skip button mode + per-song switch in the player menu, visible playback error banner with cause hint and copyable details; tests

- Credits: ArchiveTune (rukamori & contributors) in About and docs/CREDITS.md
- Lyrics (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): Binimum provider, enhanced LRC word times on repeated lines, per-song offset ±5 s, AI translation via OpenRouter (own key in Keychain, model, own prompt, test) with fallback, translation source shown; tests
- Docs: round 10 plan (ArchiveTune canary features, Resona for Android)

- Fix optional chaining in the Deezer lyrics parser
- Docs: round 9 progress
- Lyrics accounts: Deezer (web login reads the ARL cookie, or paste; JWT + pipe GraphQL with word/line sync; Keychain only, sign out, expiry → 'sign in again') and Musixmatch with the user's own token (desktop API, falls back to guest); settings section with status and 'create free account'; tests
- Full-screen lyrics: status bar + home indicator hidden, ✕/⋯ hidden until a tap on a free area (3 s), both as lyrics settings (default on); UI test reveals the buttons by a header tap
